string-array.name: walking_tips
string-array.item: Aim for a 30-minute brisk walk most days — it counts even when split into 10-minute chunks.
A short walk right after meals helps digestion and steady blood sugar.
Try to reach your daily step goal before the evening; every step adds up.
Walk with a relaxed posture: shoulders back, chin up, arms swinging gently.
Take the stairs, park a little farther away, and pace while on phone calls.

string-array.name: morning_routine_items
string-array.item: Start with a glass of water before anything else.
Stand tall and do slow neck rolls and shoulder rolls, 10 each.
March in place gently for 60 seconds to wake up your legs.
Cat–cow stretch: 8 slow cycles on hands and knees.
Standing forward fold: hang relaxed for 20 seconds, then roll up slowly.
Finish with 5 slow, deep breaths in and out.

string-array.name: exercise_items
string-array.item: Wall push-ups — 2 sets of 8–10. Hands on a wall, body straight, bend and straighten the elbows slowly.
Chair squats — 2 sets of 8–10. Sit onto a chair and stand back up; hold the chair back if needed.
Heel raises — 2 sets of 10. Rise onto your toes and lower slowly; hold a support for balance.
Bird-dog — 2 sets of 8 per side. Extend one arm and the opposite leg, keep your back flat, move slowly.
Seated leg raises — 2 sets of 10 per leg. Straighten one leg at a time from a chair.
Do everything at your own pace — never to the point of pain. A little every day beats a lot once a week.
